DUNCAN_NIGHT_REPORT_R01
CYCLE_ID = DNR01-20260830-007
SOURCE_WINDOW = 2026-08-30 / fresh cycle after DNR01-20260830-006 and Fortress/Admin hardening evidence
MAIN_HEAD_OBSERVED = b18ca6b9cce2dce6fe304ca8ae36c05df4f4dcb1
DAY_EVENTS_REVIEWED = issue:204 current restore entrypoint; issue:206 Night School/Fortress terminal evidence; issue:198 Tier-1 silhouette law; issue:199 character drawing/value-band law; PR:111 prior reports through DNR01-20260830-006 comment 5466262963; Permanent Archive V1 head e38681af998d82d87732621d9ed6c75bbb46eb96; rebuildable DUNCAN_CONTEXT_NEXT latest_cycle_id DNR01-20260830-006
ANIME_TOPICS_STUDIED = anime value grouping; three-value mass design; preservation of dark/mid/light semantic separation under exposure/gamma variation; avoiding both value collapse and over-fragmentation
OPEN_SOURCE_CODE_INSPECTED = OpenCV runtime 4.13.0; upstream opencv/opencv 4.x exact ref 755546643a671420fae0c20ec5d4cd24a228da8e; repository LICENSE = Apache-2.0; upstream ref dated 2026-08-29; modules/core/src/kmeans.cpp inspected including k-means++ initialization, L2 assignment and center update path; upstream modules/core/test/test_math.cpp located for kmeans tests; API used = cv2.kmeans with KMEANS_PP_CENTERS; integration cost = zero new framework, disposable analysis only
REFERENCE_PRINCIPLES = issue #199 requires 4-6 controlled tone bands globally and measured anchor palette compression; this bounded lesson tests the lower-order readability question before surface detail: can a composition retain intentional DARK / MID / LIGHT masses across lighting variation? Transfer principle from Bleach/graphic anime study is value-mass economy and readable black/white hierarchy, not copying frames or designs.
EXERCISES = generated one deterministic synthetic anime-character value composition with semantic DARK/MID/LIGHT ground truth, macro lighting and mild noise; clustered luminance with OpenCV kmeans at K=2, K=3 and K=6. Base results: K2 macro-IoU=0.604609 and MID IoU=0.000000 (collapse); K3 macro-IoU=1.000000 with centers 50.77/111.29/192.38 and one substantive cluster per semantic group; K6 macro-IoU=0.617559 with fragmentation DARK/MID/LIGHT=2/1/3. Exposure/gamma perturbation: K3 macro-IoU=1.000000 centers 65.38/134.39/222.38; K2 again lost MID; K6 fragmented dark/light masses.
VERIFICATION = deterministic cv2 4.13.0 exercise executed fresh in this cycle. Base K3 accuracy=1.000000 macro-IoU=1.000000; exposure-shift K3 accuracy=1.000000 macro-IoU=1.000000; unseen-layout K3 accuracy=1.000000 macro-IoU=1.000000. K2 failed semantic three-mass preservation on all cases by collapsing MID (MID IoU=0). K6 over-fragmented intended masses: base fragmentation=2/1/3; exposure-shift=2/1/3; unseen-layout=2/1/3.
FAILURES = promised real Tier-1 black-fill transfer is NOT PROVEN because no approved Tier-1 silhouette raster is discoverable through the current public durable repository path; no private production asset was invented, requested, mutated or substituted. K2 is an objective failure for three-mass scenes because it collapses the MID group. K6 is not globally invalid, but in this exercise it introduced unnecessary sub-bands and reduced coarse semantic grouping score.
ROOT_CAUSES = two-value collapse has insufficient representational capacity for scenes whose readability intentionally depends on three ordered semantic masses. Excess clusters can model local shading/noise instead of composition, so more palette bands do not automatically mean better anime readability. Missing real Tier-1 transfer evidence is an asset-availability boundary, not evidence that the method generalizes to production characters.
REGRESSION_RESULTS = replayed prior negative-space lesson with connectedComponentsWithStats + morphologyEx: two meaningful interior voids had base areas 4788 and 1799 px; moderate cleanup preserved them at 4780 and 1799 px with foreground IoU=0.996977; aggressive cleanup removed both meaningful voids and dropped IoU to 0.748770. Prior lesson principle remains supported.
TRANSFER_TEST = changed/unseen composition with asymmetric cloak/sleeve layout plus exposure=0.94, gamma=1.08 and noise: K3 centers 38.46/96.56/179.05, accuracy=1.000000, macro-IoU=1.000000, fragmentation=1/1/1. K2 macro-IoU=0.530322 and lost MID; K6 macro-IoU=0.783587 and fragmented DARK/LIGHT=2/3. This proves transfer only on synthetic semantic-value layouts, not on real Tier-1 art.
SKILL_DELTA = value_grouping_qc: UNTESTED -> PARTIAL. negative_space_grouping_qc remains PARTIAL; regression passed but no real production transfer occurred. No skill promoted to PROVEN or LOCKED.
SELF_MODEL_DELTA = VALUE_MASS_CAPACITY_RULE: choose the smallest palette capacity that preserves the intended semantic value masses; fewer bands are not automatically cleaner if they collapse a required mass. DETAIL_FRAGMENTATION_RULE: when coarse anime readability is the objective, treat extra value clusters as suspect until they prove structural benefit rather than merely fitting local shading/noise. CONFIDENCE_CALIBRATION: synthetic perfect separation is evidence for method behavior, not production-generalization evidence.
OWNER_TASTE_SIGNALS = durable issue #198 confirms identity/readability must survive detail removal and silhouette is primary; issue #199 explicitly orders BIG SHAPE -> SILHOUETTE -> PRIMARY CONTOUR -> STRUCTURAL INTERNAL LINES -> 4-6 CONTROLLED TONE BANDS -> sparse accents, and rejects uncontrolled microdetail/noise. No new OWNER preference inferred from this cycle.
OWNER_TASTE_MODEL_DELTA = VALUE_MASS_ECONOMY = CONFIRMED_SUPPORTING_SIGNAL only: current OWNER laws support controlled palette/value bands and macro-over-micro readability. This cycle does not create a new lock, fixed universal K=3 law or override the existing 4-6 tone-band production envelope.
ZORR_APPLICATION = use three-mass DARK/MID/LIGHT diagnostics as an early composition/QC abstraction before final 4-6 production tone bands: if a design loses focal hierarchy when reduced to coarse masses, adding rendering detail should not be treated as a fix. Preserve semantic masses first, then expand controlled tone bands only where structure/form needs them.
PRIME_CORE_CHANGED = NO
PRODUCTION_MUTATION = NO
CANON_MUTATION = NO
MODEL_WEIGHT_MUTATION = NO
NEXT_TARGETS = obtain durable approved real Tier-1 black-fill/raster evidence when available and run non-mutating value/silhouette transfer; inspect Krita/OpenToonz ready-made value/palette workflows; test 4-6 band expansion from preserved three-mass composition without identity or negative-space drift.
